Package org.bsc.langgraph4j

Class GraphPath

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.GraphPath
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<String>
public final class GraphPath extends Object implements Iterable<String>
Represents a path in a graph, consisting of a sequence of string elements. This class is immutable and provides methods for path manipulation and traversal.

The path elements are separated by '/'.
